yes i acknowledge the issue; the current reconnect pipeline is tailored for rtmp, is tbf quite messy and it's been on my todo list to revisit it for SRT.
I've fixed some of the issues, but it will require some time for a good definitive fix.
In the meantime, I recommend limiting the number of reconnects.

issue.body:
### Description
The mpegts output used with srt protocol has long been plagued by reconnection issues, leading to crashes.
This fixes (hopefully) the issue.
This also fixes the following bugs:
- crash when using a pkt_size != 1316 with SRT;
- crash when using an invalid URL with SRT.

### Motivation and Context
The reconnection logic proved difficult to implement for several reasons:
- the reconnection with rtmp and the logic used in backend (in obs-output.c) is difficult to adapt to the mpegts muxer; it would require to track several bools, which make very easy to be sidetracked along the many paths of failure.
- on srt side, the srt_connect function can return a success in socket non-blocking mode and caller mode, which would trigger a signal to obs UI of OBS_OUTPUT_SUCCESS, while no connection has really been made.
- this could lead to crashes because the UI and the real state of the output might not be in sync, leading to crashes.

In order to fix the issue, we have:
- reworked the mpegts reconnect logic by moving the start and stop functions to a single thread controlled by a mutex, so that these two pipelines are now mutually exclusive. This avoids one major point of failure by preventing a call to start while stop has not finished cleaning up. We have followed the logic used in the whip output which is much simpler to implement than the 
multi-layered bools used in rtmp-stream.c.
- made explicit checks on the socket connection state on the srt protocol side, so that an OBS_OUTPUT_SUCCESS code is never returned before having ascertained that a successful connection was realized.

This fixes:
https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/issues/11062
https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/issues/11620
https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/issues/11721
https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/issues/12133
https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/issues/11885

### How Has This Been Tested?
Used the clumsy app to simulate a complete network failure.
OBS detects correctly a network disconnection.
It triggers correctly the reconnect thread from obs-output.c.
The reconnects start.
After a few reconnects, upon reestablishment of the network, obs manages to reconnect.

### Types of changes
- Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- Code cleanup (non-breaking change which makes code smaller or more readable) 

### Checklist:
- [x] My code has been run through [clang-format](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/blob/master/.clang-format).
- [x] I have read the [**contributing** document](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.rst).
- [x] My code is not on the master branch.
- [x] The code has been tested.
- [x] All commit messages are properly formatted and commits squashed where appropriate.
- [x] I have included updates to all appropriate documentation.
